description: Get the workspace's setup checklist, the next step, AI credits left, and plans. Use it right after signup and whenever the user asks what to do next. Pass setup_key from verify_signup_code, or call it while signed in. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

name: get_setup_status
title: Get workspace setup status
